LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.0.label: Hunter’s Trail
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.0.descripti: Requires Pursuit Mark learned from its augment card. Retains the original dash, damage, range and cooldown; the tree does not teach the skill for free.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.1.label: Tracked Quarry
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.1.descripti: Three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, mark it for 6 seconds. One mark, with an 8-second creation cooldown. When Pursuit Mark actually damages that enemy, consume the mark to refund 10% of this cast’s remaining cooldown, up to 1 second. Switching targets resets the count; secondary damage does not count.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.2.label: Hunter’s Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.2.descripti: When Pursuit Mark actually damages an enemy, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. A cast that deals no damage grants nothing. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.3.label: Quarry Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.3.descripti: After Tracked Quarry consumes its mark and refunds cooldown, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.4.label: Quarry Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.4.descripti: After Tracked Quarry consumes its mark and refunds cooldown, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.5.label: Assault Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.5.descripti: When Pursuit Mark actually damages an enemy, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.6.label: Covered Assault
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Hunt013.nodes.6.descripti: When Pursuit Mark actually damages an enemy, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight a 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally, it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 25.
